_readme: Sky legends: airframe TYPES that pay the legend bonus in Skydex and have a per-type world-first. This is a separate axis from the rarity tier (see rarity.md) — a legend may sit at any tier. Keyed by ICAO designator. Kept short on purpose: a legend must feel like an event. Mirrors AIRCRAFT_LEGEND_TYPES in the Skydex application; drift fails the publish.
